text:
olivia (oncall-sre): paging: GPU pool appears stuck at max nodes, autoscaler not able to add instances, queue growing rapidly. getting 5xxs for some hosted customers. starting triage.
incident_bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPUPoolAlert fired for pool 'eu-west-3-gpu-pool' — queue length 12k, avg wait 24s, scale attempts failing (x3). See /incidents/3300001111.
andrew (eng-runtime): seeing repeated 429s from cloud provider during scale API calls. logs show `ERROR scale: rate limit exceeded` followed by `deadline exceeded` on create.
maya (infra): checking quotas — project quotas look fine. provider reports transient scale API throttling in eu-west-3 region. support ticket opened.
sam (oncall): what's current impact to customers? any high-sev?
chris (support): two customers reported 503s and slow responses via tickets. support escalated one to P1 (on-call notified).
jordana (product): flagged in status page? we should prep a short customer note.
olivia (oncall-sre): mitigation plan: 1) try manual scale up to bypass autoscaler for immediate capacity 2) enable fallback routing to smaller models for hosted API routes 3) throttle new requests to non-critical customers (apply temporary rate limits). executing now.
andrew (eng-runtime): manual scale create started: `gcloud compute instances create --zone=europe-west3-b --count=4 --labels=gpu-pool=eu-west-3` — hitting same 429s about 20s apart.
maya (infra): provider support says they are mitigating throttles, ETA unknown — advised to retry with exponential backoff.
sam (oncall): olivia, can you add a temporary capacity cap per customer so we stop queue from growing more?
olivia (oncall-sre): yes, pushing temporary per-api-key rate caps now. applying config to gateway: `limits.set("hosted-rpm", 30)` across tier-standard. will take ~45s.
incident_bot: Change applied: gateway limits update rolled out to 6 of 8 regions (2 pending).
andrew (eng-runtime): deployed a hotfix to autoscaler retry logic to increase jitter/backoff; will roll to 100% in 2m. diff: `retry(backoff=exp, jitter=true, max_retries=8)`.
maya (infra): manual pool add succeeded for 2 of 4 nodes after retries. nodes are initializing — GPU drivers installing.
chris (support): P1 customer is back to ~normal for now, still seeing odd tail latency spikes. have notified them of ongoing infra mitigation.
jordana (product): posting an incident banner now: "Degraded performance for some GPU-backed hosted workloads in EU region; mitigation in progress". keep me posted for customer-facing timeline.
sam (oncall): handoff planned at +1h to morning oncall. olivia and andrew will prepare notes.
olivia (oncall-sre): quick diagnostics: autoscaler  logs show stuck reconcile loop at `evaluatePoolScaling` due to an internal lock that didn't release after repeated API errors. suspect deadlock in scale-controller when critical path hits a non-retriable error. capturing logs for postmortem.
andrew (eng-runtime): adding immediate workaround: mark the problematic scale-controller process as restartable by orchestration (currently flagged critical). restart initiated: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/scale-controller -n infra`
incident_bot: rollout restart started for deployment/scale-controller.
maya (infra): restart completed, controller recovered. autoscaler resumed normal scale decisions; queue dropping to <2k.
olivia (oncall-sre): nice. leaving rate caps in place for 15m then reassess. opening postmortem ticket: PM-INC-3300001111.
jordana (product): will update customers in 30m with timeline and what we changed. thanks all.
andrew (eng-runtime): immediate action items I'll own: 1) revert temp autoscaler change if it introduces regressions, 2) add more robust handling for provider-429 in scale controller (code + tests), 3) add alerting for stuck reconcile loops.
maya (infra): infra action items: 1) coordinate with provider about rate limits root cause, 2) add regional fallback to other zones if one zone's API is throttled, 3) run chaos test simulating provider API 429s.
olivia (oncall-sre): ops action items: 1) refine emergency rate-limits playbook (who toggles, thresholds), 2) improve handoff template for night->day shift, 3) include quick restart step for scale-controller in runbook.
chris (support): support action: prepare FAQ snippet for customers on expected behavior and mitigations for GPU pool events.
jordana (product): schedule postmortem review with stakeholders tomorrow 10:00 UTC. include engineering, infra, support, and product.
sam (oncall): copying final status: mitigated — autoscaler restarted, manual node adds in place, temporary rate caps active. monitoring for 45m before close.
incident_bot: Incident status changed to MONITORED. Next update scheduled in 30 minutes.
olivia (oncall-sre): last note before handoff: collected controller logs, node provisioning logs, and provider ticket ID PROD-48291. attaching to PM-INC-3300001111. handing off to morning oncall; thanks team. :clap:
